a: Dragging one step of a scale rewrites every other step whose amount has more than four decimals
Switching a scale with base 0 to the `factors` rule flattens every step to the base
A dragged factors step whose factor rounds to zero does nothing, though the round-59 ruling says an unreachable step is overridden
inferTokenType reads a shadow whose color nests a function as a string
inferTokenType treats `dvh`/`svh`/`lvh` as dimensions but not `dvw`/`svw`/`lvw`, nor `vi`/`vb`/`cqi`/`cqb`/`cqmin`/`cqmax`
b: Dragging one step of a scale rewrites every untouched step whose amount has more decimal places than the slider rounds to
Escape on a scale-step drag leaves the step overridden at its old value, and can refit its factor
Picking a color for a transparent token writes a fully transparent color, so the pick has no visible effect
A scale whose steps are all whole numbers can only be dragged or stepped to whole numbers
A scale's long name runs under its reset button
A token overridden to an empty value shows the unset color, not the overridden accent
